description: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Angola will host the 21st Extraordinary Session of the Assembly of Heads of State and Government of the African Union (AU) in Luanda on 30 August, focusing on strengthening mechanisms for conflict prevention and resolution in Africa.
title: Africa: Angola to Host 21st Extraordinary African Union Summit

description: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Benin President Romuald Wadagni will take part in the 21st Extraordinary Session of the African Union Conference on strengthening conflict prevention mechanisms in Africa, scheduled to take place in Luanda on 29 and 30 August.
title: Africa: Benin President to Attend AU Summit in Luanda

description: [Premium Times] As the 17th session of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification enters its final week in Ulaanbaatar, ministers and global leaders will focus on finance, water, land, and food systems.
title: Africa: COP17 - Finance, Water, Land Top Agenda As UN Desertification Talks Enter Final Stretch in Mongolia

description: [African Arguments] When Tendai Moyo's daughter, Rudorwashe Grace, was born in a Zimbabwean hospital, she struggled to breathe, her lips turned blue, and feeding exhausted her. Recognising instantly that her baby was seriously unwell, Tendai repeatedly sought medical help, but her concerns were ignored. Because her daughter's illness was invisible and she appeared to others like a healthy baby, her symptoms were even dismissed as witchcraft.
title: Africa: 500,000 Children Are Born With Congenital Heart Disease in Africa. Where Are the Hospitals to Treat Them?

description: [Vanguard] ABUJA-- A new policy analysis has warned that the fast-growing gambling industry in low-income areas of Nigeria, Ghana, and Sierra Leone is worsening economic hardship for young people and may be driving increased debt, youth unrest, and certain kinds of crime.
title: Africa: Surge in Betting Fuels Poverty and Crime Across West Africa - Nextier Report

description: [Liberian Investigator] MONROVIA - Elected presidents in West Africa are sliding into dictatorship by bending courts to their will and reducing legislatures to echo chambers, former President George Weah told Africa's largest bar association on Sunday, warning that a leader who takes office through a clean ballot can end up governing no differently than the soldiers who seize power at gunpoint.
title: Africa: Weah Warns West Africa of Tyrants Elected At the Ballot Box

description: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Participants of the 76th Session of the World Health Organization (WHO) Regional Committee for Africa (RC76) joined a symbolic health walk on Sunday from the Adwa Victory Memorial to Meskel Square in Addis Ababa.
title: Africa: WHO RC76 Participants 'Walk the Talk' in Addis Ababa, Championing Healthier Africa

description: [New Times] Africa's youthful population is often described as its biggest opportunity. But without stronger links between education, skills and employment, the continent risks turning its demographic dividend into an economic burden, experts have warned.
title: Africa: Africa's Talent Gap Is No Longer Just About Skills, Experts Say

description: [UN News] Conflicts can expose civilians and detainees to grave abuses; the challenge is not only to document these crimes, but also to ensure all survivors are recognised, protected and able to access justice and care.
title: Africa: Breaking the Silence Over Sexual Violence Against Men and Boys in War

description: [UN News] For Ari, a six-year-old boy with learning difficulties in Jamaica, artificial intelligence (AI) opened the door to something many children take for granted: reading a book in his own language. Thousands of miles away, gold miners in Ethiopia are being screened more quickly for tuberculosis, while communities around the world are breathing cleaner air thanks to faster detection of methane leaks.
title: Africa: AI for Good - How the UN Uses AI to Advance Human Rights
